verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਰਖ ਮੂਲ ਸੀਚੀਐ ਸਲਿਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਖਾ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿਓ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau birakh mool seecheeaai salil taa te saakhaa saakhaa patr patr kar hario hoi hai ||

en.bdb: Just as by watering the roots and trunk of a tree, all its leaves and branches become green.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਕਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise patibrataa patibrat sat saavadhaan sakal kuTa(n)b suprasa(n)n dha(n)n soi hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a faithful, truthful, virtuous wife remains attentive in the service of her husband, the whole family praises her, adores her very happily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੁਆਰ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਤੁਸਟਿ ਪੁਸਟਿ ਅਵਿਲੋਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise mukh dhuaar misaTaan paan bhojan kai a(n)g a(n)g tusaT pusaT aviloi hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the mouth eats sweetmeats and all the limbs of the body feels satiated and strong.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਬਰੰ ਬ੍ਰੂਹ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurdhev sev ek Tek jaa(n)h taa(n)h sur nar bara(n) braooh koT madhe koi hai ||468||

en.bdb: Similarly, the obedient disciple of the Guru who instead of other gods and goddesses is ever keen to obey the command of his Guru, everyone and all the gods praise him and call him blessed. But such an obedient and loyal disciple of the True Guru is very rare-perhaps one in a million.  (468)
